extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612683 issued; northeast quarter of section 14, township 40, range 26; receipt for instrument signed but not dated; note attached to the receipt states patent delivered to John Guerue by Oliver Guerue and wife January 1, 1918; conveyance to Joseph Valandra dated April 3, 1913 for $2000.00 subject to mortgage; document received at Rosebud June 1929 | TASK 5 PART 4 KIMI CROSS-REFERENCE PATCH 2026-05-02: Allotment number corrected from '170. 10G9' to '1069' per Kimi v3/v4/v5 cross-reference. Garbled OCR of handwritten allotment number '1069'. Kimi v3, v4, and v5 all confirm 1069. Sibling record part4_questionnaire_003 also has allotment 1069. Sonnet's '170. 10G9' is a misread — almost certainly the digit grouping plus the cursive '6' read as 'G'.
